# IHTML (Interactive HTML)

> Visual editor for HTML/CSS animations. Desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, plus Android. Two outputs: standard `.html` to publish on the web, and `.ihtml` (a re-editable document) that opens with the free IHTML Mirror app (desktop and Android). No backend, no accounts.

## What IHTML is

IHTML (Interactive HTML) is a web animation editor: a canvas with artboards and pages, a keyframe timeline, a visual property inspector, no-code actions (events like click, hover, scroll, view, time, start, typing), editable vectors with morphing, physics (friction, gravity, bounce), and export to a single HTML file or separate HTML + CSS + JS.

- The **Editor** creates; **IHTML Mirror** (free app, desktop and Android) opens and runs an `.ihtml` file. An `.ihtml` carries the whole project embedded (elements, animations, actions, fonts, images, video): it's both the result and the re-editable source. It is NOT a file meant to open directly in a browser; that's what Export HTML is for, which generates a standard `.html` file.
- IHTML Mirror positions itself as an interactive alternative to the PDF: animated, logic-driven documents that work with no internet. Use cases: business (proposals, catalogs, offline interactive advertising at trade shows/booths), health (patient materials, consent forms), education (interactive books and notes, with real text and ARIA roles for screen readers). Public / semi-private / private distribution (AES-256 encryption) with optional expiration.
- Installs as an app (Windows, macOS, Linux; Mirror also on Android); can also be run from source with `npm run dev`.
- Projects live on the user's machine; the editor works offline. Optional diagnostic telemetry (errors and version, never project content).
- Public runtime API via `window.ihtmlDocument`.
- Localized to 8 languages (EN, ES, PT, FR, DE, IT, JA, ZH) and 6 themes (light and dark).
- Pricing: Free plan US$0 (full editor, exports image PNG/WebP/JPEG, no HTML export) and Full plan US$4/month or US$36/year (import and export .html and .ihtml, GIF and video).
- Made by Casimiro Ondo Obiang (CEO and Lead Developer).

## Public API (runtime)

`window.ihtmlDocument` exposes: `playTimeline(name)`, `pauseTimeline(name)`, `gotoTimeInTimeline(name, seconds)`, `isTimelinePlaying(name)`, `timelineNames`, `getElementById(id)`, `triggerAction(id)`, `getVariable(name)`, `setVariable(name, value)`, `variableNames`.

## Minimal example

```html
<script>
  // Plays the timeline named "Intro" on load
  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    ihtmlDocument.playTimeline("Intro");
  });
</script>
```
